721240101.text: Why? Why can't I find it?

721240103.text: I'm looking for... for... I've forgotten. Each time I think I'm about to remember it, it disappears from my mind.

721240104.text: Hey, do you know what I'm supposed to be looking for?

721240111.text: Curses, curses! Why can't I remember?

721240108.text: I already have, it isn't on my person.

721240109.text: Even though I don't remember what I was after, I can tell when something's not what I'm looking for. Whatever it is, it's not on me.

721240110.text: Come on, what is it, what am I looking for...

721240201.text: Come, draw your weapon and try your chances against me.

721240302.text: I have cut countless people down, and have never once lost. Now that I have tasted defeat at your hands... I have bet and lost. I shall have no regrets even if it has cost me my life.

721240305.text: Haha! I draw my sword to kill. You do not?

721240306.text: You fight strangely, and your bearing is far from normal. Not at all like those who I cut down.

721240307.text: Which school do you belong to?

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for the blade mentioned by the nameless samurai
Search for the blade mentioned by the nameless samurai

721240602.text: I remember. This... one of the two children used this sword.

721240603.text: That child, he and his friend sneaked off to the smelting plant to obtain two identical swords that the smiths had discarded.

721240604.text: The finest of blades were made there, but these two were of an inferior make, so those two children...

721240605.text: I remember now, they would be mocked by others for not being able to afford swords made by famous smiths, and for using junk.

721240606.text: Hah. I say, as long as it can slay foes in battle, it is a good blade.

721240607.text: Who in this world is born bearing gold and jade? Nor does the battlefield distinguish between the noble and the lowly.

721240608.text: Samurai, have you ever been on the battlefield?

721240610.text: You have not sought out a master despite your abilities? Folly.

721240612.text: You should. One strike, and one strike only, is all it takes for someone to fall, whether they be a mighty general or a lowly ashigaru! Hahaha.

721240613.text: But... I cannot die. No matter how many swordsmen or ronin came to challenge me, I was never defeated.

721240614.text: Those who are only swordsmen in name... They fled, or they were all cut down. Hahah!

721240615.text: You are the only one who has managed to defeat me... Curses. Curses! How did I lose?

721240617.text: Again! We will go again! I will not lose this time!

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the blade to the nameless samurai

721240703.text: I will let you prepare. Takatsuki Dougire and I will be here, no matter how long we must wait.

721240704.text: Use your full strength against me once you are ready.

721240706.text: Many have said this before Takatsuki Dougire cut them down. How many blows will you withstand?

721242801.text: Well, if you're ready to lose...

721242802.text: Many have said this before Takatsuki Dougire cut them down. How many blows will you withstand?

721240901.text: Armored and armed men... does he mean soldiers from an army camp?

721240902.text: If we head east from here, we'll reach some land that's mostly flat. Maybe that's where the camp is.

721240802.text: Will you not tell me where you learned your swordsmanship from?

721240805.text: Do all true masters hide their true selves like this? Never mind. I shall not pry.

721240806.text: It has been so long since I felt this fulfilled. Discarding all pointless thought and giving myself over to the blade.

721240807.text: How strange... My body remembers this refreshing feeling as well.

721240808.text: It's almost like... I could gain acceptance, own everything in this world... when I was wielding my sword, when my all was focused on winning victory.

721240809.text: Yes, that's right. I once wielded this sword to sunder many armored bodies.

721240810.text: I remember how I felt then. Mora and honor could all be gained by the sword. As long as I had the last laugh at the end of the raging battle, what did anything else matter? To the victor go the spoils!

721240811.text: The spoils, the glory... So, I had such moments of satisfaction in my time, did I? When I was crowned with honor, acknowledged by my superiors, when the wine flowed freely...

721240812.text: Wine... wine... How could I forget the wine I drank under the moonlight with my companions? I miss that taste.

subQuests.subQuestName: Help the nameless samurai find the wine

721241101.text: I hope this fragile peace will hold out a little longer...

721241102.text: Do you know of a nameless samurai?

721241103.text: I've never heard of some strange guy like that. You're barking up the wrong tree here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask the soldiers about the wine

721241301.text: The Sangonomiya rebels are just riff-raff.

721241302.text: Do you know of a nameless samurai?

721241303.text: Hmm. Born into a fishing village, joined the army, and that manner of speech... I think I know who you're talking about.

721241304.text: After that last battle ended, a lot of folks went missing in action, that guy included.

721241305.text: Usually, people who end up unaccounted for have either deserted or... you know, bought the farm.

721241306.text: But that guy? With his skills, I don't think any of those riff-raff from Sangonomiya could have beaten him. I thought he'd fled.

721241307.text: I never would've imagined that he'd lost his memories and become a madman who only knows how to wield a sword.

721241308.text: Well then, were you here to ask about him, or did you want to do something else?

721241310.text: Eh? You know, I wouldn't necessarily call losing your memories of the battlefield a bad thing, exactly.

721241313.text: But you look like a good person. I mean, you came all this way just to help him out.

721241314.text: As an old friend of his, I would like to help, but...

721241315.text: As you can see, I have my duties here, and I cannot leave.

721241316.text: I just need the wine that he drank in the past.

721241317.text: Wine... That's all you need, then?

721241318.text: I've got it. I'll give you my personal bottle of it, in fact.

721241319.text: Back when he was still in the army, he, a friend from his hometown, and I would drink together.

721241320.text: They were both of lowly birth, and would often be ostracized by those fools from richer families.

721241321.text: He was a rough man who didn't care a whit about being excluded. He just threw himself into battle all the same...

721241322.text: The General at the time quite liked him, and raised both him and his hometown friend to the rank of Hatamoto.

721241324.text: *sigh* I always come to back to something awful whenever I think about the past. There's no point in nattering on, so I shan't.

721241325.text: Well, you have the wine. If there's nothing else, best you take your leave.

721241326.text: This is a military encampment, after all. If you tarry here too long, people might get the wrong idea.

721241312.text: His past? As far as I'm aware, it's nothing particular happy...

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the wine to the nameless samurai

721241501.text: This wine... it's bitter. That's not right.

721241502.text: I remember that the wine we drank before wasn't like this. It only had the taste of excitement and joy.

721241503.text: We took names and won glory... Should we not have been pleased with ourselves? And yet, why does this wine go down my throat so bitterly?

721241504.text: And this bottle, I remember it. It has to be...

721241505.text: He would take this bottle, and he would say: "Come on, Masanori, have another!"

721241509.text: Yes, yes, I remember! I would often drink with the same person. He and I were like brothers, and we would talk often.

721241510.text: But there was just this once, when he said something that... led to an argument, and so he left.

721241511.text: He was my brother-in-arms, through thick and thin. Why would he just leave like that... Why?

721241512.text: What did I do wrong? Do you know, samurai?

721241701.text: Defeated by the same person thrice. How am I this weak? I have honed my martial arts ability from childhood to today... How am I so useless?

721241702.text: Useless... useless... I'm a useless samurai... Wait, I remember now.

721241703.text: I saw a sword fall from someone's hands, and it wasn't Takatsuki Dougire. The sight of that sword sent me trembling all over, and my courage failed me...

721241704.text: I feared that fallen sword, and I fled from there, and ended up here.

721241706.text: I... I fled here from the <color=#00E1FFFF>tidal flats in the northwest</color>. That was where the battle took place.

721241707.text: Why was I so afraid of that sword? What happened there?

721241710.text: Remember, I have to remember, that sword... that sword...

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for the blade mentioned by "Masanori"
Search for the blade mentioned by "Masanori"

721241801.text: Remember, I have to remember, that sword... that sword...

721241901.text: This is that sword. Yes, that was his sword.

721241902.text: But where is he? Where did he go? We agreed to go home together!

721241904.text: Why wasn't he there!? Argh... How can this be!!!

721242001.text: I... I have truly been defeated.

721242002.text: I put everything on the line to wield my sword, but the martial arts that I so worshiped... they have been truly and pathetically beaten.

721242005.text: You need not worry. I lost control earlier... Never again will I raise my hand against you of my own will.

721242006.text: I fought you to my heart's content four times, and discovered some shattered memories, obtained two swords, and a bottle of wine. I am satisfied.

721242007.text: Moreover, the more I remember, the more I feel anger and a deep pain rise up from within me. Perhaps my past is indeed far from a beautiful story.

721242008.text: I doubt I will gain much from becoming obsessed with it, so it is best that I put it down.

721242009.text: Nonetheless, I believe it to be greatly fortuitous that we met. I do not regret it.

721240401.text: Who were those two children? Ugh, my head hurts. I can't... remember...

721240403.text: Yes... they lived in <color=#00E1FFFF>a hut in the fishing village to the north</color>... the hut was <color=#00E1FFFF>under a cliff</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>surrounded by sea on all sides</color>.

721240404.text: They would take the <color=#00E1FFFF>steps behind the house</color> to the <color=#00E1FFFF>slope</color> to spar... Their blades might still be there.

721240405.text: A samurai's word is his bond. I will wait here for you until you have brought me those swords.

721241001.text: Who did I drink with... what did we say...

721241201.text: Hmm? Why is a civilian like you wandering around in the military camp?

721241202.text: Do you know of a nameless samurai?

721241203.text: Serving no master, and slaying no foe on the battlefield. The person you speak of must be a ronin.

721241204.text: There is no place in my army for such a person.

721241205.text: Besides, order is valued above all here in a military encampment. This is no place for civilians to walk in and out of as they please. Please leave quickly.

721241601.text: My head... It hurts... Please, I beg of you, fight me once more. Use your blade to help me remember. Help me remember everything!

721241603.text: What? What are you waiting for?

721242601.text: Let us duel once more, you and I.

721242702.text: I will let you prepare. Takatsuki Dougire and I will be here, no matter how long we must wait.

721242703.text: Use your full strength against me once you are ready.

721243701.text: My head... It hurts... Please, I beg of you, fight me once more. Use your blade to help me remember. Help me remember everything!

721243802.text: What? What are you waiting for?

721244001.text: I hope this fragile peace will hold out a little longer...

721244002.text: Do you know of a nameless samurai?

721244003.text: Huh. This person you speak of seems rather strange. I've never encountered such a person.

721244004.text: That said, there's been an arrest warrant out for some reckless fool who actually dared to take the Shogun on. That certainly sounds a little like the person you're talking about.

721244005.text: What does the wanted fugitive look like, you ask? Uh... How did I forget that? Really, now...

721244006.text: But I'd stay away from that guy if I were you. What if they're the wanted fugitive? I'd focus on keeping my head on my shoulders if I were you.

721244101.text: Hmm? Why is a civilian like you wandering around in the military camp?

721244102.text: Do you know of a nameless samurai?

721244103.text: Serving no master, and slaying no foe on the battlefield. The person you speak of must be a ronin.

721244104.text: There is no place in my army for such a person.

721244105.text: Are you just here to look for someone? If you are, please leave as soon as possible.

721244106.text: I've received word that some scoundrel infiltrated the city and attempted to ambush our Almighty Shogun. My forces have also received an arrest warrant for this criminal.

721244107.text: Well, you've also got blond hair. Best you leave, or you might be mistaken for that wanted fugitive.

721244108.text: Looking at your thin build, forget surviving a battle with the Shogun — I personally doubt you'd be able to parry my spear even once. I have no wish to involve commoners in these struggles unnecessarily.

721244109.text: Still, you do look quite familiar...

721244201.text: The Sangonomiya rebels are just riff-raff.

721244202.text: Do you know of a nameless samurai?

721244203.text: Hmm. Born into a fishing village, joined the army, and that manner of speech... I think I know who you're talking about.

721244204.text: After that last battle ended, a lot of folks went missing in action, that guy included.

721244205.text: Usually, people who end up unaccounted for have either deserted or... you know, bought the farm.

721244206.text: But that guy? With his skills, I don't think any of those riff-raff from Sangonomiya could have beaten him. I thought he'd fled.

721244207.text: I never would've imagined that he'd lost his memories and become a madman who only knows how to wield a sword.

721244208.text: Well then, were you here to ask about him, or did you want to do something else?

721244210.text: Eh? You know, I wouldn't necessarily call losing your memories of the battlefield a bad thing, exactly.

721244213.text: But you look like a good person. I mean, you came all this way just to help him out.

721244214.text: As an old friend of his, I would like to help, but...

721244215.text: As you can see, I have my duties here, and I cannot leave.

721244216.text: I just need the wine that he drank in the past.

721244217.text: Wine... That's all you need, then?

721244218.text: I've got it. I'll give you my personal bottle of it, in fact.

721244219.text: Back when he was still in the army, he, a friend from his hometown, and I would drink together.

721244220.text: They were both of lowly birth, and would often be ostracized by those fools from richer families.

721244221.text: He was a rough man who didn't care a whit about being excluded. He just threw himself into battle all the same...

721244222.text: The General at the time quite liked him, and raised both him and his hometown friend to the rank of Hatamoto.

721244224.text: *sigh* I always come to back to something awful whenever I think about the past. There's no point in nattering on, so I shan't.

721244225.text: Well, you have the wine. If there's nothing else, best you take your leave.

721244226.text: This is a military camp, after all, and there's been an arrest warrant out and about lately. Things are really tight right now.

721244227.text: Strangers like yourself would be wise not to stay here long, or some people might get the wrong idea.

721244212.text: His past? As far as I'm aware, it's nothing particular happy...

721244301.text: Remember, I have to remember, that sword... that sword...

721249801.text: *sigh* This guy isn't gonna listen to a word you say. Come on, let's go and try to find that sword before he goes berserk again.
